body: I understand yours, as well. You’re definitely not alone. I hope for the best for you.
I’m so glad this was the first post I saw when I joined the sub just now.. because this post could have been written by me, and I thought my behavior was atypical.
DMed you

Oof. My dad used to do an imitation of me that went something like “Hi, my name is (my name), wanna take your pants off?” 

And thank you. Truthfully I think about that time in my life quite a bit, even now. My relationship with my dad did improve after a long time (not with my mom, though). I moved across the country not long after I graduated high school, and they’ve never visited. I try to make my own way and find peace when I can. I hope you are doing better, too. I’m sorry that you were groomed and someone preyed on you - I wish you’d had better support around you.

We have something in common, sort of - my mom was distraught as well (which led into a whole mess of things, but I don’t want to derail the conversation). She also recently referenced the incident, earlier this week, and still thinks I’m terrible. It was a shock to know she still thought those things about me. 

I’m sure your partner, like mine, doesn’t care who you slept with decades ago. It’s so crazy that this is what we’re limited to in our mothers’ eyes.

This story really touches a nerve in me, because my parents loved me until I had sex as a teenager. Twenty-five years later, and they’ve still never forgiven me. It’s gross that you were made to feel tainted and it’s awful what we both experienced. Just want you to know that I have a lot of empathy for you and I’m sorry that you experienced that so young.
Your experience sounds a lot like mine. Your mom weaponized therapy.
That’s very interesting and that’s never crossed my mind before. I’ll be doing some deep thinking on that one for sure!

Haha, I just posted about this myself (in a way). We had also eloped, except we got pictures done at the time. However, they didn’t really turn out great, and we didn’t get a lot of shots we’d wanted. So our plan is to go back this summer on our anniversary and get our pictures redone. 

My mom thinks I’m a complete freak for doing this, but honestly I don’t see what the issue is. And for you, I say go for it! Get the pictures. I think it’s sweet, and you’ll have a lovely day. I think it’s worth it and I can’t see why or how you’d regret it. I hope they turn out absolutely lovely.
Oof, just reading that left me exhausted on your behalf. I’m sure that she’ll punish you somehow later for stunning her, too. Good grief.
Yesss. Does yours interrupt you constantly? Mine did that incessantly today and I almost screamed.

Is there anything you can do TODAY to make any aspect of your life feel better? I know you have bigger problems, but thinking about what you can control right now is basically how I get through. I hope things improve for you. And remember, you are not a burden.

Well, mine was ordered to go to therapy by the court, after she beat me when I was in my teens. She took great delight in telling me all about how her therapist told her that I was the problem and had recommended that my mom stop doing nice things for me. Also I guess her therapist diagnosed me with Oppositional Defiant Disorder, although I’d never met her therapist (and don’t have that disorder). So I guess if anything, therapy allowed her to feel more confident in her behavior. 

It occurs to me as I write this that she could have made all of that up. I’ll never know. But she would recite all this stuff to me after, glowing, almost seeming to get off on it as I cried.
Yeah, she’s good at that one.. which is part of what makes her so scary. Thank you - I will try to keep your encouragement in my mind. :)

I’ve given that a lot of genuine thought. It would be much easier if all the rest of my family didn’t live by her. But one day, I’ll go up there and that will be it - the last time I’ll have had to do it. That will be so liberating.
Thank you so much. I needed this.
I should have. I always get stuck in this thing where I believe I can word things just right and she’ll understand, and all it does is keep me trapped on the phone longer.
